sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Chest-up man turned three quarters toward screen-left with a stern closed mouth and blue eyes; thick dark-brown swept-back raised quiff and short side hair; dark eyebrows, clearly visible short moustache and close dark beard/stubble across cheeks, jaw and chin. Preserve the conspicuous short vertical forehead/brow scar and diagonal pale/dark cheek scratches beside the screen-right eye rather than smoothing them away. Dark brown charcoal trench coat with large raised folded collar and angular lapels over a very dark open high shirt; no hat, eyewear or tie. Retain upper-left lighting, right-side shadow, crop and continuous gray-brown painted photographic backing. Keep hair/beard distinct from the yellow mascot skin and make its neck short and broad within the same coat opening.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Chest-up bearded man facing three quarters toward screen-left with serious closed lips and blue-gray eyes. Tan brown fedora with a broad black band, short dark side hair, strong dark eyebrows, full dark beard with lighter flecks along cheeks/chin and connected moustache. Brown suit jacket with broad notched lapels and light folded pocket square on screen-right; light gray-beige shirt buttoned high, no tie. Keep hat brim, facial hair, coat cut, crop, lighting and continuous gray painted background, adapting the collar to the compact short broad mascot neck.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Chest-up clean-shaven young man looking slightly toward screen-left; voluminous curly/wavy medium-brown hair swept high and back, dark clear eyebrows and large rounded brown/metal framed glasses with transparent lightly gray lenses so both eyes remain visible. Preserve the tight serious closed mouth and smooth bare upper lip, jaw and chin, with no moustache or beard. Pale cream shirt has a wide open folded collar over an olive-brown outer garment with a broad angular V-shaped opening; no tie or hat. Maintain the original garment contours, left light/right shadow, crop and continuous gray painted backing; use a compact broad mascot head and short neck fitted to that open collar. Original alpha243..255 is recorded; the actual image is a complete painted rectangle with no visible exterior cutout.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Chest-up man in three-quarter screen-left pose with neatly swept-back short reddish-brown hair, dark brows and a prominent dark upward-curled handlebar moustache. Upper lip moustache only: keep cheeks/jaw/chin smooth without a beard. A long cigar projects from the mouth toward screen-left with a glowing ash tip and a thin curling plume of smoke; preserve the original cigar angle and smoke. Retain the clearly visible diagonal pale cheek scratch on screen-right. Red-brown suit jacket, cream buttoned shirt and dark olive tie, no hat or glasses. Keep crop, upper-left lighting and full gray painted backing, with short broad yellow mascot neck fitted closely into the shirt collar.
